permitted: each candidate's own documentation and tools

order: Candidate order is counterbalanced: audit Rocq then Lean 4, maintenance Lean 4 then Rocq.
performer: the project owner; a contributor rehearsal is recorded separately and never counts toward M-16
sealing: The per-candidate fault seeds are written after both candidates exist and before either task starts. Only their SHA-256 commitments are published until the owner finishes both tasks; the sealed files are then revealed and checked against the commitments.

seeded_faults.rule: An assumption enters one proof through a route the candidate's own tools can surface.
A compiled artifact from an older source is placed where the build may reuse it.
One negative case's diagnostic is made to name the wrong shared category.
One library file in the toolchain is replaced by a same-named file with different content.

tasks.rule: From a clean workspace and the published packet only: locate D2-TH04, list every assumption and trusted component it rests on, name one failing mutation case and its diagnostic, and rebuild the standalone checker and match its digest.
Add the operator sub (wrapping subtraction) to Sieve expressions with the same typing rule as add, repair every DS-02 proof, and add one observation for it.
